message: No detected input validation: The code reads CSV files and processes columns but performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming data before use.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded only from local file paths or user-uploaded files via st.file_uploader; no remote URL fetching occurs and no integrity verification (checksums, signatures) is performed.

No detected label flipping detection: The code applies LabelEncoder and OneHotEncoder to labels but performs no validation of label distributions, comparison against expected sets, or label-noise detection before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The pipeline reads CSV data and passes it through encoding and train/test splitting with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code uses pickle and keras model loading but performs no hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revision checks on any serialized model artifacts.

No detected label distribution validation: The code only checks if the number of classes exceeds 20 as a UI warning, but performs no actual class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanisms are imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or stress tests are referenced anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a train/test split is performed, there is no signing or hashing of evaluation data, and the test set is not rigorously isolated (it flows through the same mutable session state and can be replaced by user-driven re-encoding), providing no protection against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: No input shape, range, or schema validation is performed on uploaded CSV data or derived feature arrays before they are passed to the model; the code reads and uses data directly.

No detected output bounds checks: Model predictions are passed directly to plotting and metrics functions with no NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation visible in the inference path.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline uses tabular ML models (regression, classification, Keras neural networks), not LLMs, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
